stem: A painful red eye with halos, vomiting, a mid-dilated poorly reactive pupil and markedly raised intraocular pressure suggests:
answer_explanation: Acute angle closure causes sudden painful IOP elevation, corneal edema and a mid-dilated poorly reactive pupil.
reference_text: Original NEET-PG/INI-CET-style test item; Subject: Ophthalmology; Topic: Acute angle closure. Not a recalled PYQ; medically unverified.

stem: A cherry-red spot at the macula with retinal whitening is classic for:
answer_explanation: Acute retinal arterial ischemia causes diffuse retinal pallor while the fovea remains relatively red, producing a cherry-red spot.
reference_text: Original NEET-PG/INI-CET-style test item; Subject: Ophthalmology; Topic: Retinal vascular disease. Not a recalled PYQ; medically unverified.

stem: Primary open-angle glaucoma is usually characterized by:

options.label: B
options.text: Chronic progressive optic neuropathy with an open anterior chamber angle

options.label: D
options.text: Marked corneal edema in every case

answer_explanation: Primary open-angle glaucoma is typically chronic and insidious, with an open angle and progressive optic nerve damage.

stem: Bitot spots are associated with deficiency of:

stem: The most specific routinely used biomarker for myocardial necrosis is:
answer_explanation: Cardiac troponins are highly sensitive and specific biomarkers of myocardial injury and are central to the diagnosis of myocardial infarction.
reference_text: Original NEET-PG/INI-CET-style test item; Subject: Medicine; Topic: Acute coronary syndrome. Not a recalled PYQ; medically unverified.

stem: An ECG showing an irregularly irregular rhythm with no discrete P waves is most consistent with:
answer_explanation: Atrial fibrillation produces chaotic atrial activity, absent discrete P waves and an irregularly irregular ventricular response.
reference_text: Original NEET-PG/INI-CET-style test item; Subject: Medicine; Topic: Arrhythmias. Not a recalled PYQ; medically unverified.

stem: The defining level of proteinuria in adult nephrotic syndrome is approximately:
answer_explanation: Nephrotic-range proteinuria in adults is classically greater than about 3.5 g per 24 hours.
reference_text: Original NEET-PG/INI-CET-style test item; Subject: Medicine; Topic: Nephrotic syndrome. Not a recalled PYQ; medically unverified.

stem: Which combination best fits SIADH?

options.label: B
options.text: Euvolemic hyponatremia with inappropriately concentrated urine

answer_explanation: SIADH causes water retention, usually euvolemic hyponatremia, low serum osmolality and urine that remains inappropriately concentrated.

stem: The primary acid-base disorder in diabetic ketoacidosis is:
answer_explanation: Accumulation of ketoacids produces a high anion gap metabolic acidosis.
reference_text: Original NEET-PG/INI-CET-style test item; Subject: Medicine; Topic: DKA. Not a recalled PYQ; medically unverified.

stem: Primary adrenal insufficiency typically causes:
answer_explanation: Loss of aldosterone and cortisol in primary adrenal failure commonly causes hyponatremia and hyperkalemia.
reference_text: Original NEET-PG/INI-CET-style test item; Subject: Medicine; Topic: Adrenal insufficiency. Not a recalled PYQ; medically unverified.

stem: The pathogenic antibody in Graves disease is directed primarily against the:
answer_explanation: Thyroid-stimulating immunoglobulins activate the TSH receptor, causing hyperthyroidism.
reference_text: Original NEET-PG/INI-CET-style test item; Subject: Medicine; Topic: Graves disease. Not a recalled PYQ; medically unverified.

stem: Persistent airflow limitation in COPD is reflected spirometrically by:

options.label: C
options.text: Normal residual volume in all patients

options.label: D
options.text: Isolated reduction in diffusion capacity in every patient

answer_explanation: COPD is characterized by persistent airflow obstruction, classically a reduced post-bronchodilator FEV1/FVC ratio.

stem: Which laboratory finding is most characteristic of uncomplicated iron deficiency anemia?
answer_explanation: Low serum ferritin is the most characteristic indicator of depleted iron stores in uncomplicated iron deficiency.
reference_text: Original NEET-PG/INI-CET-style test item; Subject: Medicine; Topic: Iron deficiency anemia. Not a recalled PYQ; medically unverified.

stem: Which metabolite rises in vitamin B12 deficiency but not isolated folate deficiency?
answer_explanation: Vitamin B12 is required for methylmalonyl-CoA metabolism, so methylmalonic acid rises in B12 deficiency.
reference_text: Original NEET-PG/INI-CET-style test item; Subject: Medicine; Topic: Vitamin B12 deficiency. Not a recalled PYQ; medically unverified.

stem: The most common quadrant for carcinoma of the breast is the:
answer_explanation: Breast carcinomas occur most often in the upper outer quadrant, where there is more glandular tissue.
reference_text: Original NEET-PG/INI-CET-style test item; Subject: Surgery; Topic: Breast. Not a recalled PYQ; medically unverified.

stem: The sentinel lymph node is best defined as:

options.label: B
options.text: The first draining lymph node or nodes from a primary tumor region

options.label: D
options.text: The last node in the lymphatic chain

answer_explanation: Sentinel nodes are the first lymph nodes receiving drainage from the tumor area and are sampled to assess regional spread.

stem: A palpable, non-tender gallbladder in a jaundiced patient classically suggests:
answer_explanation: Courvoisier's sign points toward malignant obstruction of the distal biliary tract rather than chronic stone disease.
reference_text: Original NEET-PG/INI-CET-style test item; Subject: Surgery; Topic: Obstructive jaundice. Not a recalled PYQ; medically unverified.

stem: The classic pain pattern of acute appendicitis is:

options.text: Right iliac fossa pain migrating to epigastrium

options.label: B

options.label: C
options.text: Left iliac fossa pain migrating to umbilicus

options.label: D
options.text: Suprapubic pain migrating to left hypochondrium

stem: Which enzyme is generally more specific for acute pancreatitis?
answer_explanation: Serum lipase is more specific and remains elevated longer than amylase in acute pancreatitis.

stem: A hemodynamically unstable patient with suspected tension pneumothorax requires:
answer_explanation: Tension pneumothorax is a clinical emergency and should be decompressed immediately without waiting for imaging.

stem: Using the classic Parkland formula, initial crystalloid requirement in the first 24 hours is:
answer_explanation: The classic Parkland formula is 4 mL of lactated Ringer solution per kg per percent TBSA burn, with half given in the first 8 hours from time of burn.

stem: Multiple central dilated small-bowel loops with step-ladder air-fluid levels most strongly suggest:

stem: The most common site of tubal ectopic pregnancy is the:

stem: New-onset hypertension due to preeclampsia classically develops after:

stem: The most common cause of primary postpartum hemorrhage is:
answer_explanation: Uterine atony is the most common cause of primary postpartum hemorrhage.
